stories.start_quote: אמרו עליו על הלל הזקן שלקח
stories.summary_en: Hillel the Elder provided an impoverished man of good family with a horse and a servant, and once, finding no servant, ran before him himself for three miles.

quotes: שלקח למני בן טובים אחד סוס לרכוב עליו
tags.why: providing for a poor man according to his former status
praises a Talmudic sage, copied from Ketubot
cited as an exemplum within a section on gemilut hasadim
the sage himself runs before the poor man
